mechanism: Echinacea may have immunostimulatory properties that could theoretically oppose the immunosuppressive effects of ACE inhibitors, and some echinacea preparations contain compounds that may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially affecting captopril metabolism minimally.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and renal function; counsel patient to inform providers of echinacea use, particularly during acute infections when echinacea is typically used.
